items.title: See everything Echo ran
items.text: Settings → Activity shows each run, its tokens and cost, and what went in and came out, step by step on a timeline.

items.title: Send traces to Langfuse
items.text: Send Echo's runs to Langfuse or your own collector, off until you set it up, never your account and only with text when you allow it.

items.title: Thread sync at a fraction of the tokens
items.text: Each thread sync now reads its new calls, mail and chats in one answer instead of many steps, using far fewer tokens.

items.title: Your company's telemetry left alone
items.text: When your organisation sets up Claude Code's telemetry, Echo leaves it as it is and keeps only its own record.

items.title: Plugins that read the web
items.text: A plugin you allow can read any public web page over https, never this computer or your own network.

items.title: Plugins that read files and audio
items.text: Plugins can read the text of PDFs and Office files you hand them and transcribe audio with Echo's own speech model.

items.title: Plugins that talk with Claude
items.text: A plugin's Claude can look at pictures, answer as it writes and carry a conversation on from turn to turn.

items.title: Start a new conversation
items.text: When a Claude session has ended, its panel offers New conversation beside Resume.

items.title: Plugin update notice that clears
items.text: The older Echo plugin notice ignores projects that are gone and checks each AI profile's own Claude Code, naming the profile.

items.title: Search what was said
items.text: Press Enter in the Calls search to find words across calls, mail, channels and documents, with filters, and open each moment beside the list.

items.title: Sharper search for Claude
items.text: Search drops common words and the minutes' header links, and uses meaning only to reorder what the words found, so Claude gets fewer stray hits.

items.title: Recall becomes Intake
items.text: What Echo reads from your threads' mail and channels, and whom it trusts, now lives in Settings → Intake, kept in files with daily backups.

items.title: A leaner Recall
items.text: The Sources and People screens, Also discussed and the page reader are gone, as people and relations now come from the Knowledge plugin.

items.title: More for plugins
items.text: Plugins read each person's role and reporting line and each thread's AI profile, reading people is fast at any size, and a slow plugin call no longer hangs.

items.title: Turn routines on as you install
items.text: Each routine a plugin brings has its own switch on the plugin's install sheet, so you no longer go to the Scheduler to start it.

items.title: Plugins that work with your folders
items.text: Plugins can read and edit the folders you give them, keep their history in git and ask Claude Code about them on your click.

items.title: Knowledge in Settings is now Recall
items.text: Echo's search across your calls, mail and folders is called Recall, so a Knowledge plugin can bring your own vaults.

items.title: Minutes counted in any language
items.text: Today counts the decisions and open questions of minutes written in Russian or Ukrainian too.

items.title: Safer plugins
items.text: Plugins never write into hidden settings folders, and the skills they add to Claude Code can't run commands.

items.title: Echo's jobs, tracked like routines
items.text: Each job Echo runs by itself keeps its runs, cost and next run, shown in the Scheduler's System tab beside your routines.

items.title: Quiet nights, fewer calls
items.text: Needs you now asks the model only about what's new, on Haiku, and Echo's own jobs pause at night, so far fewer model calls run while you sleep.

items.title: Tune Echo's own jobs
items.text: See every job Echo runs by itself and set how often each runs, when it pauses and which model it uses, in the Scheduler plugin or with echoctl jobs.

items.title: Your provider's model names
items.text: If your company's gateway names Claude's models its own way, tell each AI profile which model it runs for Haiku, Sonnet and Opus.

items.title: More company Claude tools
items.text: A company's Claude Code program that answers its version with just the number can now be added in Settings.

items.title: Claude through your company's tool
items.text: If your company gives you its own Claude Code program, add it in Settings and Echo runs Claude through it.

items.title: Thread updates cost less
items.text: Threads now read new mail and chat together and send Claude far less each time, so keeping them current uses fewer tokens.

items.title: Templates keep every section
items.text: Tick Keep every section and minutes follow your template exactly, with the end time and screenshots where you put them.

items.title: Plugins keep threads up to date
items.text: A plugin you allow can move a thread's stage and add its own tasks, and your own edits always win over it.

items.title: Dashboards from your plugins
items.text: Plugins can offer ready-made dashboards: add one from the + beside a thread's or client's tabs, only if you want it.

items.title: Scroll past busy widgets
items.text: Long tables and lists show what fits and a +N more line, so the page always scrolls under your mouse.

items.title: Scorecards and real funnels
items.text: Plugin tables can show trends, heat maps, stage mixes and a total, and funnel charts now look like funnels.

items.title: Smaller fixes
items.text: A plugin marketplace that can't be read now says why and how to sign in to it.

items.title: Claude knows your plugins
items.text: Claude in Echo now sees which plugins you have and reads each one's guide only when it works with it.

items.title: Routines and Yolo act like you
items.text: Routines and Yolo now get the same knowledge and permissions as your Claude session, set by one choice in Settings.

items.title: See what Yolo did
items.text: Yolo runs lists every run with what it changed, sent or drafted, so you can check what Claude did on its own.

items.title: Calls show who really came
items.text: A recorded Teams call now shows the people who were in the meeting, not everyone who was invited.

items.title: What's new after each update
items.text: After an update Echo shows what changed, and you can open it again from the menu bar, ⌘K or Settings.

items.title: Smaller fixes
items.text: Dates in another year show the year, plugin widgets fill their row, and Sign in to Claude shows at once.

items.title: Plugins share a setting
items.text: Plugins from the same marketplace can share a value, like a project code, so you set it once for all of them.

items.title: Safer plugin installs
items.text: A plugin can add to your Claude Code only the one plugin its install sheet names, nothing else.

items.title: Widgets name the right page
items.text: A widget on a thread's Brief or a client's Overview now shows that thread or client in its header.

items.title: One filter for a whole dashboard
items.text: Add Filters to Today and set the period, thread or client once for every widget beside it.

items.title: Export a dashboard
items.text: Export, beside ✎, saves the page as one HTML file that opens anywhere.

items.title: Pages use the full width
items.text: Brief, Overview and dashboards now fill the window, and long text stays easy to read.

items.title: Plugin links open on one click
items.text: A plugin's web link opens on the first click, and its address shows when you point at it.
